fields.label: Current price
fields.description: Latest closing price.

fields.label: Market cap
fields.description: Price × issued shares, in ₹ crore.

fields.label: PE
fields.description: Price ÷ earnings per share over the last four quarters. Unknown when earnings are not positive.

fields.label: Price to book
fields.description: Market cap ÷ shareholders' equity on the latest balance sheet.

fields.label: Earnings yield
fields.description: Trailing earnings per share ÷ price. The inverse of PE.

fields.label: EV to EBITDA
fields.description: (Market cap + debt − cash) ÷ latest full-year EBITDA.

fields.label: Enterprise value
fields.description: Market cap + borrowings − cash and current investments.

fields.label: ROE
fields.description: Return on equity, latest full year: profit after tax ÷ shareholders' equity.

fields.label: ROCE
fields.description: Return on capital employed, latest full year: EBIT ÷ (total assets − current liabilities).

fields.label: ROE 3Y avg
fields.description: Average ROE over the last three full years.

fields.label: ROCE 3Y avg
fields.description: Average ROCE over the last three full years.

fields.label: ROA
fields.description: Return on assets, latest full year: profit after tax ÷ total assets.

fields.label: Sales
fields.description: Revenue from operations, latest full year.

fields.label: EBITDA
fields.description: Operating profit before depreciation, latest full year.

fields.label: Net profit
fields.description: Profit after tax, latest full year.

fields.label: EPS
fields.description: Basic earnings per share, latest full year.

fields.label: OPM
fields.description: EBITDA ÷ sales, latest full year.

fields.label: Net margin
fields.description: Profit after tax ÷ sales, latest full year.

fields.label: Interest coverage
fields.description: EBIT ÷ finance cost, latest full year.

fields.label: Sales TTM
fields.description: Revenue over the last four quarters.

fields.label: Net profit TTM
fields.description: Profit after tax over the last four quarters.

fields.label: EPS TTM
fields.description: Earnings per share over the last four quarters.

fields.label: Sales growth
fields.description: Revenue, latest full year against the one before.

fields.label: Sales growth 3Y
fields.description: Revenue CAGR over three full years.

fields.label: Sales growth 5Y
fields.description: Revenue CAGR over five full years.

fields.label: Profit growth
fields.description: Profit after tax, latest full year against the one before. Unknown when the earlier year was a loss.

fields.label: Profit growth 3Y
fields.description: Profit after tax CAGR over three full years.

fields.label: Profit growth 5Y
fields.description: Profit after tax CAGR over five full years.

fields.label: EPS growth 3Y
fields.description: EPS CAGR over three full years.

fields.label: Sales latest quarter
fields.description: Revenue in the latest quarter.

fields.label: Net profit latest quarter
fields.description: Profit after tax in the latest quarter.

fields.label: OPM latest quarter
fields.description: Operating margin in the latest quarter.

fields.label: Sales growth YoY quarter
fields.description: Latest quarter's revenue against the same quarter a year earlier.

fields.label: Profit growth YoY quarter
fields.description: Latest quarter's profit against the same quarter a year earlier.

fields.label: Debt
fields.description: Total borrowings on the latest balance sheet.

fields.label: Cash
fields.description: Cash, bank balances and current investments on the latest balance sheet.

fields.label: Net debt
fields.description: Debt − cash. Negative means more cash than debt.

fields.label: Debt to equity
fields.description: Borrowings ÷ shareholders' equity, latest balance sheet.

fields.label: Current ratio
fields.description: Current assets ÷ current liabilities, latest balance sheet.

fields.label: Net worth
fields.description: Shareholders' equity on the latest balance sheet.

fields.label: Total assets
fields.description: Total assets on the latest balance sheet.

fields.label: Operating cash flow
fields.description: Cash from operations, latest full year.

fields.label: Free cash flow
fields.description: Operating cash flow − capex, latest full year.

fields.label: Free cash flow 3Y
fields.description: Free cash flow summed over the last three full years.

fields.label: Cash conversion
fields.description: Operating cash flow ÷ profit after tax, latest full year.

fields.label: Dividend payout
fields.description: Dividends paid ÷ profit after tax, latest full year.

fields.label: Dividend yield
fields.description: Dividends paid in the latest full year ÷ market cap.

fields.label: Promoter holding
fields.description: Promoter and promoter group stake, latest shareholding filing.

fields.label: Promoter holding change 1Y
fields.description: Change in promoter stake over a year, percentage points.

fields.label: Pledged percentage
fields.description: Promoter shares pledged, as a percentage of all shares.

fields.label: FII holding
fields.description: Foreign institutional stake, latest shareholding filing.

fields.label: DII holding
fields.description: Domestic institutional stake, latest shareholding filing.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Company name.

fields.label: Industry
fields.description: NSE industry classification.

fields.label: Sector
fields.description: NSE sector classification.

examples.name: Profitable and lightly borrowed
examples.query:
ROCE > 20
Debt to equity < 0.5
Market cap > 1000

examples.name: Low PE with a return on capital
Latest quarter: sales and profit up 25%
examples.query:
Sales growth YoY quarter > 25
Profit growth YoY quarter > 25

examples.name: Cash generative
examples.query:
Free cash flow 3Y > 0
Cash conversion > 1
Net debt < 0

examples.name: Paying dividends out of earnings
examples.query:
Dividend yield > 2
Dividend payout < 70
Profit growth 3Y > 5
